why.zh: AI 每次开工先读它，写一次长期省事
why.en: Your AI reads it before every task — write once, save time forever

prompt.zh: 请读一下这个项目，帮我写一份 60 行以内的 CLAUDE.md，写完给我看
prompt.en: Read this project and write a CLAUDE.md under 60 lines, then show me

title.en: Let the AI search the web

why.zh: 问最新的东西时让它先查再答，少编造
why.en: For anything recent, have it look things up first — fewer made-up answers

prompt.zh: 请先联网搜索这个问题的最新资料，再给我结论和出处：[你的问题]
prompt.en: Search the web for the latest on this, then give me a conclusion with sources: [your question]

title.zh: 让 AI 读一个网页
title.en: Have the AI read a page

why.zh: 贴个链接让它读完再总结，省得你自己翻
why.en: Paste a link and let it read and summarize for you

prompt.zh: 请读这个网页并用 5 条要点总结：[链接]
prompt.en: Read this page and summarize it in 5 bullet points: [link]

title.zh: Plan 模式：先出方案再动手

why.zh: 大改动前先看步骤，你点头再执行，返工更少
why.en: See the steps before big changes and approve them — less rework

prompt.zh: 进入 Plan 模式（Shift+Tab 切换），先给我方案，不要改文件：[你的任务]
prompt.en: Enter plan mode (Shift+Tab), give me a plan first and don't edit files: [your task]

title.zh: 让 AI 列任务清单
title.en: Let the AI keep a to-do list

why.zh: 长任务拆成清单逐项打勾，不容易漏
why.en: Long tasks get split into a checklist so nothing is missed

prompt.zh: 请先把这个任务拆成一个待办清单，再一项项完成：[你的任务]
prompt.en: Break this task into a to-do list first, then work through it item by item: [your task]

why.zh: 需求不清时让它先提问，比猜错再改快
why.en: When the request is fuzzy, questions beat wrong guesses

prompt.zh: 开始之前，如果有任何不确定的地方，先用选择题问我
prompt.en: Before you start, ask me multiple-choice questions about anything unclear

why.zh: 让子代理并行查资料，主对话保持清爽
why.en: Sub-agents research side by side and keep your main chat clean

prompt.zh: 请用子代理并行完成：A 梳理目录结构，B 找出所有 TODO，最后汇总给我
prompt.en: Use sub-agents in parallel: A) map the project structure, B) find all TODOs, then summarize

title.en: Give chores to a light model

why.zh: 格式转换这类活用轻量档更快更省
why.en: Formatting-type work is faster and cheaper on a light tier

prompt.zh: 这个任务是机械性的，请用最轻量的模型完成；如果当前不是，告诉我怎么用 /model 切换
prompt.en: This task is mechanical — use the lightest model; if you aren't on one, tell me how to switch with /model

title.en: Raise reasoning effort for hard problems

why.zh: 架构和疑难调试时让它多想一会儿
why.en: Let it think longer on architecture and tricky bugs

prompt.zh: 这个问题比较难，请用更高的推理强度仔细想清楚再回答：[你的问题]
prompt.en: This one is hard — use higher reasoning effort and think it through before answering: [your question]

why.zh: 把常干的活变成一句话能调用的能力
why.en: Turn a recurring job into a one-line command

prompt.zh: 请列出我装了哪些 skill，挑一个最适合这个项目的，用它完成一个小任务
prompt.en: List the skills I have installed, pick the best one for this project, and use it on a small task

title.zh: 用 MCP 连接外部工具

why.zh: 让 AI 直接读写 GitHub、文档等外部系统
why.en: Let the AI work directly with GitHub, docs, and other systems

prompt.zh: 请告诉我我已经连了哪些 MCP 工具，并用其中一个帮我完成一件小事
prompt.en: Tell me which MCP tools I have connected and use one of them for a small task

why.zh: 比如改完代码自动跑测试，不用每次提醒
why.en: For example, run tests after every edit without reminding it

prompt.zh: 请帮我配置一个 hook：每次改完文件自动运行测试。先告诉我要改什么，我确认后再写
prompt.en: Set up a hook that runs tests after you edit files. Tell me what you'll change first; write it after I confirm

why.zh: 会话太长时压缩，保留结论、扔掉过程
why.en: Compress a long session — keep conclusions, drop the noise

prompt.zh: 请用 /compact 压缩当前对话，只保留结论和待办
prompt.en: Use /compact to compress this conversation, keeping only conclusions and open items

why.zh: 两件事互不干扰地同时改，不怕弄乱
why.en: Change two things at once without stepping on each other

prompt.zh: 请在一个新的 git worktree 里完成这个改动，别动我当前的工作区：[你的任务]
prompt.en: Do this change in a new git worktree and leave my current working tree alone: [your task]

why.zh: Codex 的项目说明书，作用和 CLAUDE.md 一样
why.en: Codex's project brief — same idea as CLAUDE.md

prompt.zh: 请读一下这个项目，帮我写一份 AGENTS.md，控制在 60 行以内
prompt.en: Read this project and write an AGENTS.md under 60 lines

why.zh: 在项目里输入 /init，AI 会自己读代码写初稿
why.en: Type /init in a project and the AI drafts the brief from the code

prompt.zh: 在这个项目里运行 /init，然后把生成的 CLAUDE.md 给我看
prompt.en: Run /init in this project, then show me the generated CLAUDE.md

why.zh: 换话题就 /clear，上下文干净、回答更准
why.en: Switch topics with /clear for cleaner context and sharper answers

prompt.zh: （换新任务前输入 /clear）
prompt.en: (type /clear before starting a new task)

title.en: Pick up where you left off

why.zh: 用 claude --resume 或 codex resume 找回昨天的对话
why.en: Use claude --resume or codex resume to reopen yesterday's chat

prompt.zh: （在终端输入 claude --resume，选择要继续的会话）
prompt.en: (run claude --resume in your terminal and choose a session)

why.zh: 输入 @ 加文件名，直接把文件交给 AI 看
why.en: Type @ plus a filename to hand that file to the AI

prompt.zh: 请看一下 @README.md，告诉我这个项目缺什么
prompt.en: Look at @README.md and tell me what this project is missing

why.zh: 报错截图、设计稿直接粘贴进对话
why.en: Drop error screenshots or designs straight into the chat

prompt.zh: （把截图粘贴进对话）请看这张图，告诉我问题出在哪
prompt.en: (paste a screenshot) Look at this image and tell me what's wrong

why.zh: claude -p 或 codex exec 一行命令跑完就走
why.en: claude -p or codex exec runs a task in one command

prompt.zh: （在终端试：claude -p "用三句话总结这个项目"）
prompt.en: (try in a terminal: claude -p "summarize this project in three sentences")

why.zh: 把常用提示词存成 /命令，一键复用
why.en: Save a prompt you reuse as a /command

prompt.zh: 请帮我把"检查代码风格并修复"做成一个自定义斜杠命令
prompt.en: Turn "check code style and fix it" into a custom slash command for me

title.en: Have the AI review its own diff

why.zh: 改完先让它自己看一遍 diff，问题少一半
why.en: A self-review pass catches many problems early

prompt.zh: 请检查你刚才的改动：列出可能的问题和遗漏，先别继续改
prompt.en: Review the change you just made: list possible problems and gaps, and don't change anything yet

why.zh: 常用的安全命令设成免确认，少被打断
why.en: Allow safe, frequent commands so you're interrupted less

prompt.zh: 请帮我看看哪些常用命令可以安全地加入免确认列表，先列出来不要改
prompt.en: Suggest which frequent commands are safe to auto-allow — list them, don't change anything

tagline.en: Transforms technical concepts into detailed, interactive isometric SVG illustrations.
tagline.zh: 将技术概念转化为细致的交互式等距 SVG 插图。

tagline.en: A library of structured engineering flows for codebase design and technical diagnosis
tagline.zh: 用于代码库设计与技术诊断的结构化工程流程库。

tagline.en: A quality audit framework for identifying technical debt and repository vulnerabilities
tagline.zh: 用于识别技术债务和代码仓库漏洞的质量审计框架。

tagline.en: Automated vulnerability research and security reviews for codebases, APIs, and system services
tagline.zh: 面向代码库、API 和系统服务的自动化漏洞研究与安全审查。

tagline.en: Automates the design and monitoring of protein characterization experiments via cloud laboratory APIs
tagline.zh: 通过云实验室 API 自动化设计与监控蛋白质表征实验。

tagline.en: Transforms codebases and documentation into a persistent, queryable knowledge graph.
tagline.zh: 将代码库与文档转化为可持久保存、可查询的知识图谱。

tagline.en: A system for generating high-end brand guidelines and visual identity decks.
tagline.zh: 用于生成高端品牌规范与视觉识别提案的系统。

tagline.en: A comprehensive system for generating branded technical architecture and data flow diagrams.
tagline.zh: 用于生成带品牌风格的技术架构图与数据流图的综合系统。

tagline.en: An agentic skills framework for structuring the software development lifecycle
tagline.zh: 用于构建软件开发全生命周期的智能体技能框架。

tagline.en: Turns standard frontend interfaces into high-fidelity, production-grade design craft.
tagline.zh: 将标准前端界面打造为高保真、可用于生产的设计作品。

tagline.en: A library of production-grade engineering capabilities for AI coding agents
tagline.zh: 面向 AI 编码智能体的生产级工程能力库。

tagline.en: A systematic approach to creating multi-platform creative assets and digital banners.
tagline.zh: 一套系统化方法，用于制作多平台创意素材与数字横幅。

tagline.en: Directs and produces short films generated entirely through code-based animation.
tagline.zh: 导演并制作完全通过代码动画生成的短片。

tagline.en: Reduces token consumption for coding agents through compressed communication and specialized roles.
tagline.zh: 通过压缩通信与专用角色，降低编码智能体的 token 消耗。

tagline.en: Removes the structural patterns and predictable phrasing of AI-generated prose.
tagline.zh: 去除 AI 生成文本中的结构性套路与可预测的措辞。

tagline.en: A framework for building fluid mobile animations and gestures in React Native and Expo
tagline.zh: 用于在 React Native 和 Expo 中构建流畅移动端动画与手势的框架。

tagline.en: Practical coding guardrails for simpler, surgical AI-assisted changes
tagline.zh: 为更简单、更精准的 AI 辅助代码修改提供实用的编码护栏。

tagline.en: Translates natural language into parametric CAD models and 3D printing workflows
tagline.zh: 将自然语言转化为参数化 CAD 模型与 3D 打印工作流。

tagline.en: A collection of specialized capabilities for extending the functionality of LLM agents.
tagline.zh: 一组用于扩展大语言模型智能体功能的专用能力。

tagline.en: Transforms project directories and website URLs into shareable launch videos.
tagline.zh: 将项目目录和网站 URL 转化为可分享的发布视频。

tagline.en: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
tagline.zh: 借助智能体对任何对象进行逆向工程，从应用行为一直到原生二进制文件。

tagline.en: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
tagline.zh: 智能体 harness 性能优化系统。为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等提供技能、本能、记忆、安全及研究优先的开发能力。

tagline.en: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.
tagline.zh: DeepSeek Harness：一切皆插件。

tagline.en: The agent that grows with you
tagline.zh: 与你共同成长的智能体。

tagline.en: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
tagline.zh: 用来自网络及更多来源的数据为你的 AI 智能体提速。正在构建超级智能的数据库。🔥

tagline.en: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
tagline.zh: 让你的 AI 智能体像房间里最懒的资深开发者那样思考。最好的代码，是你从未写过的代码。

tagline.en: The agent engineering platform.
tagline.zh: 智能体工程平台。

tagline.en: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
tagline.zh: 将任意代码库及其文档、SQL schema、配置文件和 PDF 转化为可查询的知识图谱。适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的 /graphify 技能：本地确定性 AST 解析，每条边都有说明，不使用向量存储。

tagline.en: Open-source Python library for AI browser agents, plus Browser Use Cloud: stealth browsers and a hosted agent API.
tagline.zh: 面向 AI 浏览器智能体的开源 Python 库，并提供 Browser Use Cloud：隐身浏览器与托管式智能体 API。

tagline.en: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
tagline.zh: 一个开源 AI 智能体，可将 Gemini 的能力直接带入你的终端。

tagline.en: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
tagline.zh: 大家在工作中用来管理智能体的开源应用。

tagline.en: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
tagline.zh: 为每个智能体提供跨会话的持久上下文：记录智能体在会话中的全部操作，用 AI 压缩后，将相关上下文注入后续会话。支持 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等。

tagline.en: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
tagline.zh: Orca 是管理一批智能体（如 Grok Bot、Claude Code）的平台。可用你自己的订阅运行任意编码智能体。支持桌面端、移动端和远程运行时。

tagline.en: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
tagline.zh: 让你的 AI 智能体看见整个互联网。通过一个 CLI 读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、哔哩哔哩、小红书，无需 API 费用。

tagline.en: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
tagline.zh: 为编码智能体赋予审美品味的技能：艺术指导、参考图片与浏览器检查，而非生成千篇一律的 AI 页面。

tagline.en: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
tagline.zh: RAGFlow 是领先的开源检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将前沿 RAG 与智能体能力融合，为大语言模型打造更优的上下文层。

tagline.en: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
tagline.zh: 将任何想法、计划或代码库转化为精美的交互式图表。适用于 Claude Code、Codex 等的智能体技能。

tagline.en: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key. Join our Discord https://discord.gg/VuxzM8mtf
tagline.zh: 面向大语言模型和 AI 智能体的开源网页爬虫与抓取工具：将任意网站转为干净、可供 LLM 使用的 Markdown。可自行运行，也可用一个密钥使用 Crawl4AI Cloud。加入我们的 Discord https://discord.gg/VuxzM8mtf

tagline.en: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
tagline.zh: 一个开源的长周期超级智能体 harness，可用于研究、编码与创作。借助沙箱、记忆、工具、技能、子智能体和消息网关，它能处理耗时数分钟到数小时的不同层级任务。

tagline.en: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 375 providers (150+ free), 1,400+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 900+ contributors
tagline.zh: 让编码永不停歇。免费的 MIT 开源 AI 网关：一个端点，375 家服务商（其中 150+ 免费），1,400+ 模型，包括 Kimi、Claude、GPT、Gemini、GLM、DeepSeek、MiniMax。兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、Cline 和 Copilot。具备配额感知的自动回退，RTK+Caveman 压缩可节省 15–95% 的 token，支持 MCP/A2A，提供桌面端与 PWA。由 900+ 贡献者共同打造。

title.zh: 给项目写一个 CLAUDE.md(AI 的项目说明书),它从此记住你的规矩
title.en: Write a CLAUDE.md (a project brief for AI) so it remembers your rules

detail.zh: CLAUDE.md 是放在项目文件夹里的规则文件(Claude Code 认这个名字,Codex 认 AGENTS.md)。写清楚项目结构、常用命令、你的规矩,AI 每次对话都会自动先读,不用再重复交代。
detail.en: CLAUDE.md is a rules file in your project folder (Claude Code recognizes this name; Codex recognizes AGENTS.md). Describe the project structure, common commands, and your rules. The AI reads it automatically before every conversation, so you do not have to repeat yourself.

title.zh: 长会话记得开新会话,省钱又提质
title.en: Start fresh sessions during long conversations to cut costs and improve quality

detail.zh: 会话越长,每次请求都在为历史内容付费,而且模型注意力被稀释。一个任务结束就开新会话,大任务拆成多个会话。
detail.en: The longer the conversation, the more you pay for its history on every request, and the more the model's attention is diluted. Start a new session when a task ends, and split large tasks across sessions.

tips.source: 官方计费文档 + 社区共识

title.zh: 先让 AI 出计划,你点头后再让它动手
title.en: Ask the AI for a plan first, then approve it before it acts

detail.zh: 复杂任务先说「先给我一个计划,先不要改代码」。看过计划再让它动手,返工大幅减少。Claude Code 里有专门的『计划模式』(Plan Mode)。
detail.en: For complex tasks, say "Give me a plan first; do not change code yet." Review the plan before letting it act to greatly reduce rework. Claude Code has a dedicated Plan Mode.

tips.source: 官方文档 + 社区实践

title.zh: 用好提示词缓存,重复内容只按 1 折计费
title.en: Use prompt caching: repeated content costs just 10% of the usual rate

detail.zh: 固定的要求、参考资料放在每次提问的开头,变化的问题放末尾——AI 认出重复部分后,这部分只收约 1 折的钱。
detail.en: Put fixed requirements and reference materials at the beginning of each prompt, and changing questions at the end. When the AI recognizes the repeated portion, that part costs about 10% of the usual rate.

title.zh: 用 /compact 或开新会话前,先让 AI 总结当前进度
title.en: Before using /compact or starting a new session, ask the AI to summarize progress

detail.zh: 长会话结束前说「把已完成的结论和待办总结成一段」,存进项目笔记再开新会话——上下文清爽了,进度一点不丢。
detail.en: Before ending a long conversation, say "Summarize the completed conclusions and open items in a paragraph." Save it in your project notes before starting a new session to keep the context clean without losing progress.

tips.source: 官方文档 + 社区共识

title.zh: 连续失败两次就停,改问法而不是重发
title.en: After two consecutive failures, stop and rephrase instead of resending

detail.zh: AI 连续两次没做对,原样重发第三次几乎必然还是错的。停下来: 缩小任务范围、补充关键信息、或者换一种问法。
detail.en: If the AI gets it wrong twice in a row, resending the same request a third time will almost certainly fail again. Stop: narrow the task, add key information, or ask in a different way.
